name: Canopy Glider
lore: Silhouette originale proposée à partir du nom demandé. Aucun design canonique ni aucune statistique précise inventée.

assets.label: Canopy Glider — proposition d’identité
assets.prompt: Generate an ORIGINAL new design proposal for the 2D Yautja fan-game La Longue Chasse, based on a requested name with only partial or no precise visual specification. This is NOT a canonical film replica. Exactly TWO complete SIDE profiles SIDE BY SIDE: left view facing RIGHT, right view facing LEFT, independently draw the same construction/anatomy in opposite orientations and identical scale. Entire silhouettes must fit in the central 80 percent of each half with generous blank outer and central margins. Pure uniform MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Detailed hand-painted bitmap, no ground shadow, scenery, text, watermarks, diagram labels or grid. No human, Yautja rider, passengers, cargo, trophies, UI or effects. Empty vehicle chassis: removable weapons and props excluded. Light alien glider PROPOSAL: slim single empty pilot cradle, two articulated ribbed mechanical membrane wings tightly FOLDED along both sides, visible hinge stations and folded translucent dark green membrane sections, short tail stabilizer. Landed/stowed identity configuration. No pilot or parachute. Flight wings will be separate animation modules.
notes: Proposition statique, en revue. Les équipements, effets et mouvements restent à produire séparément.
